comparison.objective: Swap a blown fuse in a holder and close it, not separate finishing media.
comparison.physical_skill: Hinged-carrier operation, small-part extraction/insertion, and latch verification versus sifting.
comparison.success_condition: Correct fuse seated, old fuse tray-stowed, holder shut; no recovery fraction.
comparison.reason: Small-component replacement and verified latching are different abilities. Rubric versions differ only in milestone wording.
